name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency bonus +3. Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. Languages none.
appearance: A broad-jawed, ochre-brown dinosaur with short forelimbs, heavy hind legs, and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), Appendix A, p. 372. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195243-tyrannosaurus-rex
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

Bite. Melee attack roll +10, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the Bite is grappled (escape DC 17). While this grapple lasts, the target is restrained and cannot be targeted by the tyrannosaurus’s Tail.

Tail. Melee attack roll +10, reach 15 ft. On a hit, deal 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit by the Tail falls prone.

name: Venomous Snake
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A slender snake with alternating ochre, dark gray, and russet bands, shown in a loose coil.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), Appendix A, p. 372. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775847-venomous-snake
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

name: Vulture
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy brown bird with a pale bare head, hooked bill, scruffy neck ruff, and layered wing feathers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), Appendix A, p. 372. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195256-vulture
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The vulture gains advantage when attacking a creature within 5 ft. of one of its allies, provided that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee attack roll +2, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

name: Warhorse
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A muscular bay horse with a black mane, dark lower legs, and a long black tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), Appendix A, p. 373. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775848-warhorse
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee attack roll +6, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the horse moved at least 20 ft. straight toward a Large or smaller creature immediately before hitting it, deal another 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage and knock that creature prone.
